title: On a part sale, an untracked part with nothing on hand shows In Stock
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an untracked part, part A, for this test, with 0 on its shelf.
  • Create an open part sale for this test, part sale A, with no parts.
  • Start on part sale A's Parts tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click Add Part on part sale A's Parts tab.
  2. Type part A's part number in the Part Number field.
  3. Click the part A row in the list.
  4. Type 2 in the quantity field.
  5. Click the save button of the part row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The part lookup opens.

Step 2:

  • Part A is offered, reading "Not Tracked".

Step 3:

  • Part A fills the row.

Step 4:

  • The quantity reads 2.

Step 5:

  • Part A is added to part sale A with quantity 2 and carries its "In Stock" badge, although it has 0 on its shelf (0 − 2 = −2 below zero).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R22: “On work orders and part sales an untracked part keeps its "In Stock" badge whatever its quantity on hand, including zero or below.”
  • Feature Overview, Core functionality: “An untracked part is not counted. The Inventory list shows "Not Tracked" instead of its total quantity, and its Min and Max are kept but not used. Its bins and their quantities stay on screen as a shelf reference. It can still be used on work orders and invoices.”
